errors.text_span: Ос Y показва полезните жилищни площи в квадратни метри (кв. м)
errors.evidence: The y-axis label is 'хил. кв. м', which translates to 'thousands of sq. m', not just 'square meters (кв. м)'. This makes all reported values in the description incorrect by a factor of 1000.

errors.text_span: колебаяйки между 30 и 40 кв. м до 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The description states the values fluctuate between 30 and 40 until 2018. However, the data point for 2017 is approximately 25, and for 2018 it is approximately 45, both of which are outside the specified range.
